title: A voice-only letter waiting for words
note: A kept recording whose words have not been written yet shows a calm note on its card instead of text. Nothing is lost; the recording is on the phone.
text: For Asha Asha's book Read together This month Month 7 is open. Whatever you add this month lands here. Month 6 3 letters · From Mama Thursday, October 1, 2026 A recording, waiting for its words. From Mama Private 0:54 Wednesday, September 30, 2026 Bath time. You splash with your whole body, both hands, both feet, and then you check that I saw. From Mama Friday, September 11, 2026 You rolled over all by yourself, twice, and then looked at me like you had always known how. Month 5 1 letter · From Mama Tuesday, August 4, 2026 So it rained all morning so we sat by the window and you tried to catch the drops on the glass. You were so serious about it. From Mama 0:42 Month 3 1 letter · From Mama Monday, June 22, 2026 You smell like warm milk and the lavender soap Papa insists on. I could sit here all night. From Mama Month 2 1 letter · From Mama Thursday, May 7, 2026 You laughed today. A real one. It sounded like a little hiccup that surprised you as much as it surprised me. Your Nani made dal and nobody ate it because we were all watching you sleep. From Mama 0:42 Tonight Book Family
lines: Whatever you add this month lands here.
A recording, waiting for its words.
Bath time. You splash with your whole body, both hands, both feet, and then you check that I saw.
You rolled over all by yourself, twice, and then looked at me like you had always known how.
So it rained all morning so we sat by the window and you tried to catch the drops on the glass. You were so serious about it.
You smell like warm milk and the lavender soap Papa insists on. I could sit here all night.
You laughed today. A real one. It sounded like a little hiccup that surprised you as much as it surprised me.
Asha, you are four days old and the whole house is quiet. Your Nani made dal and nobody ate it because we were all watching you sleep.
